title: 5.1 Introduction to the Internet
description: The internet concepts and details. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What role does IP play in data transmission?
options: It addresses packets and chooses the route they take
It guarantees that packets arrive in the correct order
It encrypts all data before network transmission
It stores web pages on a remote web server
questions.correctAnswer: It addresses packets and chooses the route they take

questions.question: What does TCP add to the service provided by IP?
options: Unique addressing of all network devices

questions.question: What is the first step of the TCP three-way handshake?
options: Computer A sends a SYN message
Computer B sends a SYN-ACK reply
Computer A sends an ACK message
questions.correctAnswer: Computer A sends a SYN message

questions.question: Which TCP feature numbers every byte of data?
What does the sender do when an acknowledgment times out?
options: The sender retransmits the missing data
The receiver closes the TCP connection immediately
The router changes the IP address
The browser renders the page again
questions.correctAnswer: The sender retransmits the missing data

questions.question: What is the purpose of flow control in TCP?
options: To prevent the sender from overwhelming the receiver
To slow down the sender when the network becomes busy
To number every byte in each data segment sent
To close the connection politely after transfer
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent the sender from overwhelming the receiver

questions.question: What does congestion control do when a network is busy?
options: It slows down the sending rate
It speeds up the delivery rate
questions.correctAnswer: It slows down the sending rate

questions.question: Which protocol is connection-oriented and reliable?
How is an IPv4 address written?
options: As four decimal numbers separated by dots
As eight hexadecimal groups separated by colons
As a sequence of binary digits only
questions.correctAnswer: As four decimal numbers separated by dots

questions.question: How many bits does an IPv4 address use?
What is the approximate maximum number of IPv4 addresses?
How are IPv6 addresses written?
Which private IPv4 range is given in the text?
What do many ISPs offer in addition to internet access?
options: Software licenses and staff training courses

questions.question: How do ISPs help protect customers from cyber threats?
options: By blocking all incoming web traffic
By replacing all IP addresses daily

questions.question: What is housed in a data center?
Which software runs on web servers?
What does encryption through SSL/TLS provide?
options: Translation of domain names to IPs
